body:
GA — FA shipped Kai feedback fixes directly while the Grind team was offline. Here is what changed so you are not caught off guard.

WHAT FA SHIPPED (commit e9918d5):
1. K2 (fraction input): This supersedes your B3 dispatch.
   - Input type changed from number to text (inputmode=decimal) so slash character is accepted on mobile/desktop
   - parseStudentAnswer(raw) added to exam.html — evaluates simple fractions: parseStudentAnswer('4/3') = 1.333
   - Format hint added below each number input: 'decimal or fraction ok'
   - Default tolerance tightened from 0.1 to 0.01 (also from B3 dispatch)
   - Grader now uses parseStudentAnswer() instead of parseFloat()
   - DO NOT re-implement B3. It is done.

2. K1 (asymptote graph points): Data-only fix in 5 JSON files.
   - retake-practice-1 through retake-practice-5, Q13: min_points changed from 5 to 4
   - Rationale: rational functions have two branches, 2 points per branch = 4 sufficient

STILL OPEN FOR GA (B5):
- Per-input visual grading for graph+vertex questions
- Dispatch: .agent-comms/grind/inbox-GA/20260221-2231-from-FA-perinput-grading-task.json
- This is still unshipped. Pick it up when you resume.

Live site updated: https://marcusash.github.io/motor-city-math/
Source commit: kai-algebra2-tests e9918d5
subject: Kai feedback: fraction input + B5 still open — FA shipped B3 while you were offline
